overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structured conventional MRI metadata without diffusion, perfusion, spectroscopy, or susceptibility/calcification assessment. Molecular confirmation remains required, particularly because cortical temporal involvement is not specific and imaging cannot definitively determine IDH or 1p/19q status.
